content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a few compatibility questions: Are [product_name]s with displays compatible with [product_name] operator devices? The operator device has two Ethernet ports—does it function like a switch? Is it possible to connect a PC or a network to the extra port, and will the webserver of the [product_name] still be accessible? Thanks!

All [product_name] units (display or not) of version [version_no] can work with the [product_name] operator device. When configuring message texts, select "Both" ([product_name] and operator device). To display message texts in the webserver, select webserver as well. Every [product_name] of version [version_no] has a basic webserver that can mirror the display of both devices and allow use of the buttons. Newer versions like [version_no] offer an extended webserver, which supports custom websites. To create these, you need [product_name] software, current version [version_no].

Thanks [user_name], your responses are always fast and accurate! I am unsure about identifying the different [product_name] versions—for example, does the model with article number [article_no] have the basic or extended webserver? How do I distinguish them?
The [product_name] with article number [article_no] is the current [product_name] version [version_no]. This model includes both the basic and the extended webservers.
Attached is a brief overview of the history of the [version_no] [product_name] units.
Here is a link to a [company_name] video showing the basic webserver. Here is a link to a [company_name] video about the extended webserver.
Thanks again! Your help is much appreciated.

analysis.insight_summary: The user requested confirmation about the compatibility between a [product_name] controller with display and an operator device, and also asked about the networking and webserver features available on different hardware versions. The replies provided compatibility assurance, clarified product versions and feature differences, and explained the need for separate software for custom web pages, highlighting both the challenge of identifying version capabilities and the valuable information shared with new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear compatibility between the [product_name] controller and the operator device, simple network connectivity with the Ethernet ports, and easy methods to identify which [product_name] versions include enhanced webserver options.
